technical.summary: Strong bullish structure with Ichimoku cross-up and price above all MAs, but overbought conditions (RSI 9: 79.83, StochRSI, Williams %R) and weak ADX (24.91) create pullback risk; better suited for continuation trades than new entries.

fundamental.summary: No insider buying, no institutional signal, no government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 26 days create a low-conviction setup with elevated event risk.

sentiment.summary: No actionable sentiment signal: congressional trades are small-amount, mixed-direction activity by junior member; broad market sentiment neutral; news data unavailable.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (194.7) indicates extreme market stress; earnings in 26 days adds event risk; falling DXY provides minor relief for tech multinationals but insufficient to offset systemic risks.

debate.key_bull_argument: Ichimoku cloud cross-up with price above all major moving averages provides structural bullish confirmation and technical entry signal.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme overbought conditions (RSI 79.83, StochRSI, Williams %R), weak trend strength (ADX 24.91), zero fundamental conviction, earnings event risk in 26 days, and macro crisis environment (inverted yield curve, VIX 194.7) create asymmetric downside risk.

decision.entry_rationale: Ichimoku cross-up and price above all major MAs provide technical structure, but entry quality is compromised by extreme overbought conditions (RSI 79.83) and weak trend strength (ADX 24.91) at resistance.
decision.primary_risk: Macro crisis environment (inverted yield curve, VIX 194.7) combined with earnings event in 26 days and zero fundamental conviction creates asymmetric downside risk that outweighs technical setup.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding SNPS with 27 existing IT positions (5.4% sector concentration); adding here increases concentration risk without conviction improvement.
